user.title: Amazon Orders
user.description: Unofficial integration: it reads your orders from the same pages the Amazon website shows you. Signing in registers a device named "Home Assistant Amazon Orders" on your Amazon account. Your password is used once and is not stored.

data_description.site: The Amazon website you place your orders on.
data_description.email: The email address of your Amazon account.
data_description.otp: The 6-digit code shown right now by your authenticator app. Two-step verification with an authenticator app must be enabled on the Amazon account: codes sent by SMS do not work.

reauth_confirm.title: Amazon sign-in required
reauth_confirm.description: Amazon no longer accepts the stored session of {email}. Sign in again.

data_description.otp: The 6-digit code shown right now by your authenticator app.

error.captcha: Amazon asked for a CAPTCHA, which this integration cannot solve. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Amazon account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Amazon account.

data.idle_interval: While no package is out for delivery
data.active_interval: While a package is out for delivery

data_description.idle_interval: How often Amazon is checked for new orders and for changes.
data_description.active_interval: Very short intervals may make Amazon block the requests.
